note: Hotspot geometry for the Coach Office room (interim hero co_master_web.webp, 1447x1087). Coordinates are in master-image pixel space; the room-agnostic RoomScene scales them to the rendered size. HOTSPOT ORDER IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TAB/READING ORDER - a spatial walk left->right across the art (trophy_case, office_board, championship_ring_box), asserted by the office schema test. Wiring is `detail`: each hotspot opens a resolver-driven content modal whose body RoomScene supplies from its `content` map keyed by contentKey (trophy_case/board/ring_box). Zones are master-drawn on the interim art and subject to the G3 founder eyeball; the clean CO-hero render upgrades them with zero API change. framed_photos + cardboard_cutout_slot are v2 (D-2, omitted). No banner: the nameplate is a page-level runtime overlay (D-4a), not a curved banner. No baked text anywhere (CO-R4).
